description: net2 on net1 v3 against all 17 kernel controllers on the 27 test links, with 20 s and 60 s episodes and the same episode seeds for every controller: does episode length change the ranking?
prepare: P="--policy rule=$IN/models/rule-u0.25.onnx --policy oracle=$IN/models/rule-u0.25-oracle.onnx --policy learned-s0=$IN/models/learned-td3bc-n40-s0.onnx"; for d in 20 60; do uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec$d" --split test --duration-ms ${d}000 --seed 13 $P; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec$d/campaign.json" "$OUT/c$d"; done
run: for d in 20 60; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/c$d" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: A=$(jq -r 'to_entries[] | "--alias=\(.key)=\(.value)"' "$OUT/spec20/aliases.json"); for d in 20 60; do uv run expliccit score "$OUT/c$d" --reference bbr3 $A --markdown "$OUT/summary-$d.md" > "$OUT/scores-$d.json"; done; { echo '## 20 s episodes'; echo; cat "$OUT/summary-20.md"; echo; echo '## 60 s episodes'; echo; cat "$OUT/summary-60.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
